title: Canonical ATC-VM Function and Contract Catalog
supporting_repository_role: A-TownChain-Okosystems/atc-vm is specs/governance/support only, not a second production VM.

source_snapshot.note: Selected source files were fetched from this branch; complete language-aware symbol census and exact HEAD/tree reconciliation are still required.

hard_blockers: VM uses wrapping add/sub/mul while assembler simulation uses checked arithmetic; normative semantics remain BLOCKED.
Normative consensus gas schedule must be frozen/versioned by protocol governance; local default gas is not a consensus parameter.
Canonical binary ATCB decoder/version/encoding validation not established in inspected source.
Full ATCLang grammar and structural JSON parsing are not established in inspected assembler.
Host storage/event/balance/syscall interfaces and atomic state-commit boundary require versioned contracts.
Runner .ops path still uses fs::read_to_string in inspected source; bounded-input coverage must be reconciled with open PR changes.
